messages:
Ashley Chen: CI is red on the linux-arm64-cross shard after today's infra image roll. failing test: //third_party/foo:bar_binary. Full log: https://ci.internal/red/1862001111 :sob:

Ashley Chen: build error snippet:
```
ERROR: /workspace/third_party/foo/BUILD:42:11: Linking of rule '//third_party/foo:bar_binary' failed (Exit 1): gcc failed: error executing command
/usr/bin/ld: unrecognized emulation mode: aarch64linux
/usr/bin/ld: use the --emulation switch to specify the emulation mode
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

Matt K: ugh. looks like the toolchain image lost the binutils wrapper for aarch64. can someone rerun the failing job first? if it reproduces we should bisect the image roll. @CI Bot can you rerun 1862001111-2? :eyes:

CI Bot: @Matt K requested rerun. Triggered job rerun: https://ci.internal/job/1862001111/rerun-1 :rocket:

Priya N: if the linker emulation is missing, it might be because /opt/cross/bin was removed from PATH in the image Dockerfile change. i saw that in the roll diff. copying the relevant line here:
```diff
-ENV PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
+ENV PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/opt/cross/bin
```

Jules: quick reproduce (on mac/linux with qemu):
```bash
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/w redwood/ci-image:roll-2026-03-15 /bin/bash -c "bazel build //third_party/foo:bar_binary --config=arm64-cross"
```
I reproduced locally, same ld error. seems consistent.

Dani R: OK starting a bisect of the image roll. steps: revert to previous image tag, then apply intermediate layers until break. tagging @eng-oncall in case we need rollback. I'll post progress.

Ashley Chen: thanks. if this is a regression from the image, we should add a guard in ci pipeline to validate cross toolchain presence (check for /opt/cross/bin/ld). can we add a small smoke test?

Matt K: agreed. quick mitigation: pin the toolchain to old image in our bazel CI config and open a roll PR to restore /opt/cross/bin. short term fix: add this to .bazelci.yml for the arm shard:
```yaml
presets:
  - name: pin-cross-image
    env: IMAGE_TAG=ci-image-roll-2026-03-10
```

Priya N: i can open the roll PR to add the PATH back, plus add the smoke check in the image build. will do that now and link it.

Dani R: bisect update: first bad commit is roll-2026-03-15 -> removed copy step for /opt/cross/bin in layer 4. filing infra bug: INFRA-4721. tagging infra owners.

Jules: for immediate CI unblocking i pushed a temporary bazelrc in our repo to pin the image tag. CI green on rerun 1862001111-2 :white_check_mark:.

Ashley Chen: awesome, thanks everyone. Priya, post the PR when ready and put a note in the rollback runbook. I'll follow up in the infra standup.

Matt K: add an integration test that runs `file /opt/cross/bin/*` as part of image validation. small but effective. :+1:

CI Bot: Job 1862001111 rerun finished: success.

Priya N: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/ci-image/pulls/128 - adds PATH fix + smoke test. marking INFRA-4721 as in-progress.

Ashley Chen: marking this thread resolved for the repo side. leaving INFRA-4721 to infra. thanks :thumbsup:
